ayahs.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.

ayahs.tr: Hamd (övme ve övülme) Âlemlerin Rabbi Allah'a mahsustur.
ayahs.en: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.
The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Master of the Day of Judgment.

ayahs.tr: (Rabbimiz!) Ancak sana ibadet (kulluk) eder ve ancak senden yardım isteriz.
ayahs.en: It is You we worship, and upon You we call for help.
Guide us to the straight path.

ayahs.a: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.tr: Kendilerine nimet verdiğin kimselerin yolunu; gazaba uğramışların ve sapmışların yolunu değil!
ayahs.en: The path of those You have blessed, not of those against whom there is anger, nor of those who are misguided.
